assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The patient is experiencing ongoing giddiness.
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events.
The cardiac event monitor service is CPT 93271.
The cardiac event monitor service is medically necessary.
The cardiac event monitor service is not payable under coordination of benefits as the secondary payer.
The indication is documented by the diagnosis I47.1.
The indication is documented by the diagnosis G45.9.
The indication is documented by the diagnosis R42.
